name: PeeringDB API
summary: Community database of networks, internet exchanges, facilities and peering contacts, readable without a key.
description: PeeringDB lists networks (ASNs with peering policy and contacts), internet exchanges and their LANs, colocation facilities, organizations and the connections between them. Anonymous requests read the public data; an API key is available for authenticated access and writes.

required_headers.name: User-Agent
required_headers.notes: Requests with an empty User-Agent returned 403.

rate_limit.summary: Not confirmed from a response; anonymous access is throttled and a key raises limits per the docs (not re-confirmed).

endpoints.summary: Networks, filter by asn, name, info_type

example.response_excerpt: {"data": [{"id": 1, "org_id": 2, "name": "Equinix Ashburn", "aka": "", "name_long": "Equinix Internet Exchange Ashburn", "city": "Ashburn", "country": "US", "region_continent": "North America", "media": "Ethernet", "proto_unicast": true, "proto_ipv6": true, ...}], "meta": {}}

agent_notes: Filter with Django-style suffixes (__contains, __in, __lt) and cut payload with fields and depth. Look up an ASN with /net?asn=N&depth=2 to also get IX and facility records.
caveats: Data is self-reported by network operators and can be stale.
Terms and exact rate limits were not read in full today.

verification.notes: Exact example request executed without a key.
